regime.method: 8 simple checks look at groups of markets over the last week and the last month. Each check votes risk-on (investors look comfortable owning riskier things), risk-off (investors look defensive) or neutral. The banner says risk-on or risk-off only when at least 60% of the checks that have data lean the same way and no more than 1 leans the other way; otherwise it says mixed.
regime.notice: A plain checklist of market groups, for research. It describes how markets behaved over the last week and month. It does not predict what comes next and it is not investment advice. No model chooses this label.

executive_summary.rotation_view: Across the month and week, money flows show an outflow-led landscape across Country and regional markets and Metals. However, overall daily performance shows an improving trend. Equity sectors and themes remain inflow-led over the month, supported by defensive groups such as US healthcare and US consumer staples, despite tech-related weakening. Size and style trends are improving daily. Overall, the market risk tone is risk-off over the monthly horizon, shifting to a mixed risk tone across the weekly window.

Regional IT firms TCS and Infosys are also cited in news coverage. Meanwhile, official macro metrics show reductions in Federal Reserve total assets, ECB balance sheet size, and the Bank of Japan balance sheet, while US M2 money stock has increased.
